title: [vc-shell] accessibility and bundle size improvements
run_kind: re-test (verify-fix) of VCST-5412 + its 15 linked tickets

previous_run.note: Original run against framework 2.3.0. Its findings became the 15 linked tickets. Superseded by this record; see Jira comments on VCST-5412 for the full prior report.

build.theme_audited: Light (Coffee is a storefront theme and does not exist in the Vendor Portal)

provenance_gate.note: All 14 fix PRs merged BEFORE the deployed build was cut, so every failure recorded here is a real remaining defect, not a stale deploy.

ac_analysis.note: Acceptance criteria taken from the 15 linked tickets, not from VCST-5412 itself (its description is empty).

verdicts_revised_after_reading_dev_comme: Three verdicts changed once the dev comments were read: 5595 and 5599 had documented, reasoned deferrals I had first counted as misses, and 5598's notification burst was the 403 path (where the latch is designed to stay disengaged), not a dedup failure. See per_ticket_verdicts below for the final call.

bundle_size_axis.verdict: PR #255's reduction holds; the 13-fix wave cost ~1KB raw / 0KB gzip — no regression.

environment_limitations: Only ONE locale (English) provisioned — the 'switching language updates <html lang>' AC for VCST-5602/5617 is unverifiable here
VimeoAccessToken not configured — live Vimeo playback 500s (verified in Storybook instead)
Backend restricts video providers to YouTube/Vimeo, so the sandbox negative control is unreachable from the live UI (verified in Storybook instead)
A dead session surfaces as 403/AccessDenied on this deployment, so VCST-5598's 302->HTML path rarely fires
